notes: BC-0210 model-aware heuristic policy (owner decisions 2026-10-19). Same weights, window, cooldown, band targets, goal offsets and tags as heuristic-v1; only the challenge-fit grade and the novelty input differ.

grade_used = (n * grade_numeric + blend_k * predicted_grade) / (n + blend_k), n = grade_observation_count, blend_k = min_obs; challenge_fit is scored on grade_used. Without a predicted grade, grade_used = grade_numeric.

novelty = 0 for a route in recent_variant_ids (as v1), else min(1, d / novelty_distance_scale) with d the smallest cosine distance between the route's embedding and the embeddings of the recent routes; 1 when either embedding is missing.

Model outputs are precomputed (route_model_outputs) for the model versions named below and frozen into the candidate snapshot; the request path never calls a model. On a board without outputs (the synthetic demo board) v2 scores exactly like v1; only the tie-break salt (policy_version) differs.
blend_k and novelty_distance_scale are untuned defaults: there are no real climber outcomes to tune them against (Gate D1 NO-GO).
score = challenge*challenge_fit + skill_gap*0 + novelty*novelty + preference*preference_match + confidence*confidence_bonus, summed strictly left to right (Scoring.score).
